instruction: A gliding manta ray built from large flat triangles, its diamond wingspan sweeping into sharp swept tips and a needle-thin whip tail. The dorsal surface is faceted in three tones of deep indigo and slate blue, the underside in pale bone white with angular gill slashes. Two cephalic fins fold forward as blunt faceted horns above a wide rectangular mouth.
